mira_eval: nightly-eval alert: structured-output promptset failing — 47/120 failures, hallucination rate +12% vs baseline. failing examples attached :unamused:
ops_bot: nightly-eval report: model=model-v2-quantized-2026-03-20, run_id=2026-03-20T03:10Z, PASSED_PROMPTS=73, FAILED_PROMPTS=47, halluc_rate=0.184 (baseline=0.164) :warning:
adele_ml: thanks — quick context: we onboarded the new int8 transpose-fused kernel yesterday (PR #8243) and a RoPE fusion change in runtime. both landed in the same build.
sam_runtime: saw the alert, pulling logs now. suspect numerical drift in attention scaling after the fused ops.
carter_infra: can repro locally on small repro harness with seed=42. failing behavior seems length-dependent (>512 tokens) and shows early truncation or repeated <|end|> tokens.
adele_ml: example log snippet from failing trace:
```
layer=10 attention_logits mean=0.00032 var=3.1e-8 max=0.0012 min=-0.0009
softmax top1_prob=0.9987 top2_prob=0.0009 entropy=0.12
output: "...<|end|> <|end|> <|end|>"
```
mira_eval: interesting — our eval harness shows structured-output templates (json lists) most impacted. parsed fields truncated or duplicated.
sam_runtime: hypothesis: quantized weight transpose + fused RoPE implementation introduced a tiny scaling/rounding bias that, when combined with long-context positional multipliers, collapses attention distribution in mid layers. leads to overconfident softmax and early EOS.
adele_ml: ran A/B logits diff between fp16 baseline and int8 build. see per-head systematic negative shift on keys for positions > 512. attaching diffs.
jon_prod: any customer-facing incidents yet?
carter_infra: no alerts from prod telemetry, because prod mainly routes to baseline until yesterday's canary. canary traffic (1%) hit the quant build for ~2h total, we flagged failures via nightly eval not SRE. surface impact minimal so far but could affect long-form summarization customers if rolled out.
adele_ml: quick mitigation proposal:
- immediate rollback of model-v2-quantized-2026-03-20 from canary -> stop further ramp (owner: deploybot)
- gate: block any quantized kernel rollouts unless nightly structured-output promptset delta <= 3% (owner: mira_eval)
- short-term patch: disable RoPE fusion in quant path (owner: adele_ml) and rebuild int8 kernel with preserved attention scaling
- add new eval harness `rope_stress` (various lengths 512..4096, edge templates) to nightly for future gating (owner: sam_runtime)
- canary plan: re-roll to canary at 5% with golden prompts and per-request logit-variance telemetry (owner: carter_infra)
- add CI assertion: per-layer softmax entropy must not drop >0.5 bits relative to baseline for same prompt (owner: adele_ml)

sam_runtime: I'll open a quick revert PR for the fused RoPE change, mark as hotfix. ETA 2h. I'll also instrument layer-wise entropy metrics in runtime.
deploybot: action: rollback initiated for canary group. started 3061145850.
mira_eval: will add `rope_stress` to nightly and update gating rule. also creating a small deterministic regression test to run in CI.
jon_prod: thanks team. please add a short note to incident-log channel if rollback completes and when canary reroll passes. also loop in solutions engineering for customers on long documents.
adele_ml: root cause writeup draft (short):
- primary cause: minor numeric bias introduced by combined optimizations: int8 transpose kernel + fused RoPE multipliers. bias is length-dependent and amplifies for positions >512, causing attention logits to collapse toward a single token (often EOS) in mid layers.
- why missed earlier: unit kernel tests used short fixed-length sequences; long-context degenerations only appear under structured-output prompts with templates, which our generic evals didn't cover.
- mitigations: rollback fused RoPE for quant path, add `rope_stress` to nightly, gating rule on structured-output delta, CI softmax-entropy assertion, canary re-roll at 5% with extra telemetry.

carter_infra: I created a short runbook for rollback and verification steps in the deploy doc. link: https://redwood.internal/deploys/quant-rollback-306114 (internal).
mira_eval: action items summarized:
- adele_ml: open revert PR + CI assertion (ETA 2h)
- sam_runtime: add entropy telemetry + `rope_stress` harness (ETA EOD)
- carter_infra: run canary reroll and telemetry checks (ETA after revert)
- mira_eval: update gating in release pipeline and add regression to nightly (ETA EOD)

jon_prod: :thumbsup: keep updates here. if we see any customer reports escalate to oncall.
ops_bot: deploy status: rollback in progress -> canary group scaled down to 0% at 3061145899. will post final status on completion.
mira_eval: closing the loop once canary re-evaluates. thanks all :eyes:
